generations.prompt: Cinder Maw, a chunky top-heavy chibi volcanic wolf boss for a JRPG side-view battle, standing in a 3/4 pose facing right. Big horned wolf head (about 40% of its height) with two curved dark purple horns, large glowing yellow ember eyes, open jaw with white fangs. Broad chest with a round dark armoured core plate in the centre crossed by glowing orange cracks, grey-brown rocky hide with glowing ember cracks radiating from the core, short thick legs, dark spikes on its back, small ember-tipped tail on the left. Idle stance. Clean readable pixel art boss sprite with dark outline, single creature centred, feet at the bottom, transparent background.

generations.prompt: Cinder Maw, a chunky top-heavy chibi volcanic wolf boss for a JRPG side-view battle, standing in a 3/4 pose facing right. Big horned wolf head (about 40% of its height) with two curved dark purple horns, large glowing yellow ember eyes, open jaw with white fangs. Broad chest with a round dark armoured core plate in the centre crossed by glowing orange cracks, grey-brown rocky hide with glowing ember cracks radiating from the core, short thick legs, dark spikes on its back, small ember-tipped tail on the left. Idle stance. Large boss sprite that fills the canvas height. Clean readable pixel art boss sprite with dark outline, single creature centred, feet at the bottom, transparent background.
idle breathing loop: huge body rises and falls slowly, ember cracks pulse, head bobs slightly, feet stay planted in place
bite attack: rears its head back to wind up, then lunges forward to the right with jaws wide open and snaps them shut, then returns to its stance
inhale spell: plants its feet, lowers its head and inhales, the chest core and ember cracks glow brighter and brighter, then it exhales a short burst of embers
taking a hit: flinches backwards to the left, head jerks back, eyes squeeze shut, body recoils, then recovers to standing
death: roars weakly, legs buckle and it slumps down onto the ground, the ember cracks go dark, and its rocky body crumbles into a heap of ash and cooling rubble
